grammar.summary: 本课论述收藏的利弊，集中运用了动名词与分词结构、定语从句以及 what 引导的名词性从句。课文用动名词作宾语表达收藏行为，用 who/which 引导定语从句修饰收藏者与物品，用 what 引导从句充当宾语表达「所谓杂物」的概念。

points.title: 动名词与分词结构 (Gerunds & Participles)
points.explanation: 动名词作宾语表示动作本身，分词作状语表示伴随状态。本课用 without being aware of doing so（动名词）表达「无意识地收藏」，用 kept by thrifty people（过去分词）修饰线绳与包装纸。

examples.en: People tend to amass possessions, sometimes without being aware of doing so.
examples.cn: 人们喜欢收藏东西，有时并没有意识到自己在这样做。

examples.en: Among these I would list string and brown paper, kept by thrifty people when a parcel has been opened, to save buying these two requisites.
examples.cn: 这些东西中我想举出线绳和包装纸为例。节俭的人们打开包裹后便把这两样必备的东西收藏起来。省得日后去买。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 who/which 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 who 修饰 someone（收藏者），用 which 修饰 things（与过去相关的东西），使描述具体生动。

examples.en: I know someone who always cuts sketches out from newspapers of model clothes that she would like to buy if she had the money.
examples.cn: 我认识一个人，她总喜欢从报纸上剪下流行服装的图样，等以后有钱时去买服装。

examples.en: Things owned for a long time are full associations with the past, perhaps with relatives who are dead, and so they gradually acquire a value beyond their true worth.
examples.cn: 东西搁得时间久了，便会充满着与过去岁月的联系，比方说与死去的亲戚有关。因此这些东西慢慢获得了一种超出它本身的价值。

points.title: what 引导的名词性从句 (what-clauses)
points.explanation: what 在从句中既起连接作用又充当主语或宾语，相当于「所……的东西」。本课用 what can only be described as clutter 作 of 的宾语，表达「只能被称作杂物的东西」。

examples.en: Those who never have to move house become indiscriminate collectors of what can only be described as clutter.
examples.cn: 那些从来不必搬家的人们成了一种无所无容的收藏家。他们专门收藏那些只能被称作杂货的东西。

exercises.q: People tend to amass possessions, sometimes without ______ aware of doing so.
I know someone ______ always cuts sketches out from newspapers of model clothes that she would like to buy if she had the money.
Those who never have to move house become indiscriminate collectors of ______ can only be described as clutter.
用过去分词填空：Among these I would list string and brown paper, ______ (keep) by thrifty people when a parcel has been opened, to save buying these two requisites.
课文中 indiscriminate collectors 中 indiscriminate 的含义最接近？
